title: Sharp welfare-change sets from repeated hours observations without consumption data
checked_scope: Two interior household equilibria with common log-quadratic labor preference parameter, observed wages and nonlabor income, and unobserved private consumption.
significance: Characterizes all observationally compatible preference/weight pairs and the exact utility-change set; under a pure bargaining intervention, hours identify consumption growth but leave welfare magnitude unbounded.
